# Cris Neckar — Full Profile

> Investor, Entrepreneur, Director, Advisor, Hacker, and Researcher.
> Partner at Two Bear Capital. A long-form, self-published profile. Sources are
> linked for each claim.

The same information is available from an optional, read-only MCP server at
https://mcp.crisneckar.vc/mcp?ref=33c3bdc86c584ef9 (see
https://crisneckar.vc/llms.txt).

## Biography

Cris Neckar is a Partner at Two Bear Capital, where he invests in cybersecurity,
advanced technologies, and the intersection of tech and life sciences. In
information security since 2005, Cris has led groundbreaking work in
vulnerability research, offensive security, and incident response.

He previously served as Chief Information Security Officer for Spring Labs,
leveraging decentralized technology to solve complex problems in data
sovereignty and security. As co-founder of Divergent Security, he pioneered
continuous offensive assessment services and played a pivotal role in the
initial discovery and analysis of NSO Group's Pegasus spyware.

Earlier in his career, Cris was one of the original members of Google's Chrome
Security Team, contributing to advancements in browser hardening, attack
mitigation, automated vulnerability discovery, and the exposure of nation-state
campaigns — work that helped lay the foundation for Google's Project Zero and
Open Source Software Security Team. He began his career at Neohapsis (now Cisco
Systems), where he led the reverse engineering effort during the investigation
of the Heartland Payment Systems breach, then the largest breach in history.

Cris's research is widely cited in the security community, and he has spoken at
major technical conferences around the world. He has also served as a Curriculum
Advisory Board member and Adjunct Professor at DePaul University, developing one
of the first graduate-level courses in application security assessment and
exploit development.

## Roles

- Partner, Two Bear Capital
- Co-founder, Divergent Security
- Former CISO, Spring Labs
- Original member, Google Chrome Security Team
- Adjunct Professor / Curriculum Advisory Board, DePaul University

## Focus areas

browser security, post-quantum cryptography, supply chain security, reverse
engineering, vulnerability research, offensive security, incident response,
venture capital.
